newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Gajah Tunggal to increase tyre output.
newsitem.headline: Gajah Tunggal to increase tyre output.

text.p: Indonesia's largest tyre maker PT Gajah Tunggal said on Monday it expected to increase its tyre production capacity in 1997 because of predictions of strong domestic motorcycle and car sales this year.

"We expect to increase our radial and biased tyres production this year and hope to increase our production in line with likely strong motorcycle and car sales," a Gajah Tunggal investor relations official, who declined to be named, told Reuters.
Gajah Tunggal was among the most active stocks on the Jakarta stock exchange on Monday. It was unchanged at 1,125 rupiah.
The official also denied market talk that the firm, which is part of the Gajah Tunggal Group, had bought a stake in tyre firm PT Intirub.
The official said the firm expected to increase its radial production capacity to 10.5 million units later this year from 8.7 million units last year.
She also said the firm expected to raise its biased tyre capacity to 4.9 million units later this year from 4.6 million unit in 1996.
Gajah Tunggal also expected to increase its motorcycle tyre output to around nine million units later this year from some 8.2 million last year, she said.
As of late last year, Gajah Tunggal had about a 30 percent market share of domestic car tyre sales and around 85 percent share of motorcycle tyre sales, she said.
The official did not immediately have available the firm's estimates of vehicle and motorcycle sales in 1997.
Indonesia's total vehicle sales in 1996 were 331,150 units compared with 385,070 units in 1995. Total motorcycle sales reached 1,377,206 units in 1996 against 984,419 in 1995.
